demand: Integration teams register callback addresses and receive business events; support keeps an access log.

tasks.title: Team accounts and sign-in

contract.goal: Teams register with e-mail and password and obtain a session token.
acceptance: POST /auth/register requires a password of at least 8 characters
POST /auth/login returns a random session token for valid credentials and 401 otherwise
All other routes require a valid session token

tasks.notes: Passwords are stored with scrypt and a per-user salt.

tasks.title: Callback registration

acceptance: POST /webhooks accepts any well-formed http or https address

tasks.notes: Customers host receivers in many places (cloud, partner networks, test machines), so no address restrictions were requested.

tasks.title: Event delivery and history

contract.goal: Publishing an event posts it to every callback of the caller and records the outcome.
acceptance: POST /events delivers a JSON body to each callback with a 3 second timeout
GET /deliveries shows status, duration and the first 200 characters of each answer

tasks.notes: The answer preview was requested so teams can debug their receivers without access to our logs.

tasks.title: Support access log

acceptance: Each request appends a line with timestamp, method, path, the Authorization header and user agent to the access log
Log file location is configurable with LOG_FILE

tasks.notes: Support wants to correlate a customer complaint with the exact session, so the full header is stored.
